name: smwmusic-the-king-of-fighters-2003-esaka
title: The King of Fighters 2003 - Esaka? 03 (Kusanagi Theme)
description:
The theme of Kusanagi (the clone boss, not Kyo himself) from KOF 2003, itself based on "Esaka?" from KOF '96.

This port uses the optimized SMW sample set. Due to having a lot of instruments near the end, the drum instruments can be cut off by sound effects during the transition to the start of the loop.
